entry.title: Blog repository initialised
entry.summary: The development blog now exists as its own first-party repository, Heretical-Solutions/Heretical-Blog, with its source checked out in the workspace at sites/blog/. Superproject registration is a separate later step. This post records what was set up; it makes no claim about any product being released. What is in place A Jekyll site using the Chirpy theme consumed as a packaged gem, pinned ...
